purpose: Actual complete fresh/cached compact lifecycle cost acceptance on exact compatible source
network: Docker --network none; only loopback; disposable local keys; no public writes
public_acceptance: Pending pushed-head protected CI; not observed or polled
limits: Fresh ordinary receipts are actual single-ledger successes, not a fresh+cached diagnostic or replenishment.

The production-branch candidate preserves its own source APIs, without importing unmerged larger-candidate features. Final source whitespace normalization is independently compiled to exactly the tested bytecode; final runtime adds only a preflight refusal for compact caps below15M and explanatory comments.
No public fixture reruns or public effects are claimed. Protected exact-head CI, public testnet validation and independent review remain coordinator gates, pending after push.

Each suite keeps its own unchanged allowance: ordinary1.6B, security1.5B, browser150M. Device funding and cached grants remain fully charged. All unknown transactions retain their full explicitly chosen gas reservations.

Temporal proof reads the very same original fresh-created record after actual pruning. Optional retirement is measured under a separate bounded ledger with unchanged20M full reservation and0 charged fee; no claim that explicit retirement fits the nearly exhausted fresh ledger. Default ordinary execution retains the audit for later free proof reads.
The larger candidate remains an unshipped stress/compatibility fixture; its separate exact source digest is never substituted for production-branch provenance.
Physical/mainnet/manual-wallet/production-provider checks remain unrun and deferred under the authorized scope.
